description: Use to find what shoppers search for more and more right now: each keyword with its searches per week in the last 4 full weeks against the 8 before, and whether it is new. Not for one keyword's history (keyword_demand). A weekly snapshot of a cross-border search-interest proxy: what shoppers of one cross-border marketplace searched for on Amazon's US, UK, AE, IN and JP stores. A trend within that audience, not Amazon's own search volume and not live data. Price: $0.05 per answer. No required parameters: calling it bare returns the top 25. Paid data with no free calls: $0.05 per answer over x402, 10 requests with an API key. A 503 (the weekly data being rebuilt) is not charged. Every answer carries `snapshot`: the weeks it covers, `trend_as_of` (the last complete week; later weeks are partial) and when it was built. Updated weekly.
